metadata.title: Server Attestation and Trust

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for cryptographically attesting server platform and workload integrity to establish execution‑trust eligibility.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Server firmware, boot chains, hypervisors, host operating systems, workload identity, and attestation services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Supporting pattern providing cryptographic trust signals to inform Zero Trust execution decisions.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines attestation artifacts and measurements as authoritative trust data, not as credentials or entitlements.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Control authority for integrity, identification, and trust establishment (IA, SI, PL families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines that attestation produces conditional, revocable trust signals within a Zero Trust architecture.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Establishes firmware and platform integrity expectations underpinning server attestation trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines BIOS and boot integrity principles informing measured and authenticated boot.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Extends firmware integrity guidance with authenticated boot requirements for modern platforms.

metadata.remarks: Server Attestation and Trust defines mechanisms to cryptographically assert the integrity and provenance of server platforms and workloads. This pattern produces trust signals only and does not grant persistent trust, perform enforcement, or define lifecycle or remediation actions.

components.title: Server Platform Attestation
components.description: Cryptographic attestation of server firmware, boot chain, and host platform integrity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence via firmware or boot‑level compromise.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Measured and verified boot anchor platform integrity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms detect unauthorized modification of platform components.

components.title: Server Workload Attestation
components.description: Attestation of workload identity, provenance, and execution context on the server platform.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Execution of unauthorized workloads under assumed trust.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong workload identity binding prevents spoofing of execution context.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic mechanisms protect workload identity assertions.

components.title: Attestation Trust Signaling
components.description: Generation of execution‑trust signals based on attestation results for downstream consumption.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit trust signaling prevents over‑trust or ambiguous interpretation of attestation results.
